query:
SELECT
                EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM auth_password_credentials
                    WHERE user_id = $1
                      AND legacy_password_hash IS NOT NULL
                ) AS "password!",
                EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM auth_webauthn_credentials
                    WHERE user_id = $1
                      AND ($2::bytea IS NULL OR credential_id <> $2)
                ) AS "webauthn!",
                EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM auth_email_identities
                    WHERE user_id = $1
                      AND email_verified = TRUE
                ) AS "email!"
